current_wip_future_state_eligibility: Current Kalaxy3/SAGE WIP and existing capability remain evidence and candidate future-state inputs unless later objective-level evidence supports replacement, retirement, or incompatibility.

architecture_hypothesis.architect_llm_context: Persistent intent-level collaboration is preserved for efficiency, challenge, architectural exploration, and judgment.
architecture_hypothesis.sage_agent_context: SAGE owns authoritative shared state and constructs role-specific context for fresh/disposable LLM agents delivering SAGE capabilities.
architecture_hypothesis.context_isolation: Unaccepted narrative from one LLM role does not automatically become context for another role.
architecture_hypothesis.orchestration: A directed role/capability graph remains a candidate if evidence shows deterministic role selection and handoff are required.

required_experiment: persistent Architect-LLM intent plus SAGE-owned isolated role-agent context
external_view_requirement: Architect approval for production evolution requires independently inspectable evidence understandable without SAGE-internal state vocabulary or historical chat context.
